content_en.prompt: Architect Rahul produced 4 museum layouts, each with 7 numbered rooms. He wants a layout allowing a one-way tour: visitors pass through every room exactly once, without reusing a door to enter and exit the same room.
content_en.question: Which layout allows each visitor to enter, visit each room exactly once, and then exit?
content_en.explanation: Only layout C allows a one-way tour (sequence 2,1,3,4,7,6,5). In A, room 1 has only one entrance (dead end). In B, room 6 (reachable from rooms 5 and 7) forces a repeat visit to reach the exit. In D, room 6 has only one entrance.
content_en.ct_explanation: This is modeled as a graph: circles are rooms (plus "outside" before/after), lines are doors. Finding the tour means finding a path visiting all vertices — a problem graph theory shows is inherently difficult (NP-hard in general) even though this small instance is solvable by hand.

content_zh.prompt: 建築師Rahul設計了4種博物館平面圖，每種都有7個編號房間。他想選一種能讓訪客走「單向動線」的設計：每個房間恰好經過一次，而且進出同一個房間不能用同一扇門。
content_zh.question: 哪一種平面圖能讓訪客進場、把每個房間恰好逛一次、然後出場？
content_zh.explanation: 只有平面圖C能走單向動線（順序是2、1、3、4、7、6、5）。平面圖A裡1號房只有一個出入口(死路)。平面圖B裡6號房(可以從5號或7號到達)會迫使某個房間被重複經過才能到出口。平面圖D裡6號房也只有一個出入口。
content_zh.ct_skills: 抽象化（Abstraction）、演算法思維（Algorithmic Thinking）
content_zh.ct_explanation: 這個問題可以用「圖」來建模：圓圈代表房間（加上進場前跟出場後的「外面」），線代表門。找出動線就是要找一條經過所有頂點的路徑——圖論告訴我們，這種問題本質上很困難（一般情況下是NP困難），儘管這一題規模小，靠人工就能解出來。
